summary: FortuneX Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting the closing of the over-allotment option for its IPO, which had already been consummated on May 26, 2026. The filing provides an unaudited pro forma balance sheet as of May 29, 2026, reflecting the exercise of the over-allotment and related private placement. The company is a blank-check SPAC, and the filing is a routine post-IPO administrative update. There is no special-situation event such as a business combination, tender, wind-down, or restructuring. As this is a routine current report, it does not qualify as a special situation.
